title: Testing Your App
learning_objectives: Understand different types of testing in PEGA
Learn to create and execute test scenarios

introduction.title: Testing PEGA Applications
introduction.text: Testing ensures your PEGA applications work correctly and meet business requirements. This tutorial covers essential testing approaches, from basic functionality testing to more advanced debugging techniques, helping you deliver reliable applications.

sections.title: Types of Testing
sections.content: Different testing approaches serve different purposes in ensuring application quality.

testing_types.description: Testing individual components and rules in isolation
Testing how different components work together
testing_types.focus: Process flows, data integration, system connections

testing_types.description: Testing from the end user's perspective
testing_types.focus: Business workflows, user experience, requirements validation

sections.title: Creating Test Scenarios
sections.content: Well-designed test scenarios ensure comprehensive coverage of your application functionality.

scenario_types.description: Test the normal, expected flow through your application
scenario_types.example: Create a service request, assign it, resolve it, and close it successfully
scenario_types.importance: Ensures core functionality works as designed

scenario_types.description: Test how your application handles errors and exceptions
scenario_types.example: Submit incomplete forms, enter invalid data, test system failures
scenario_types.importance: Ensures graceful handling of unexpected situations

scenario_types.description: Test boundary conditions and unusual scenarios
scenario_types.example: Maximum field lengths, minimum values, empty datasets
scenario_types.importance: Identifies potential issues in extreme conditions

scenario_types.description: Test application performance under various loads
scenario_types.example: Multiple concurrent users, large datasets, complex processes
scenario_types.importance: Ensures acceptable performance in real-world conditions

sections.title: PEGA Testing Tools
sections.content: PEGA provides built-in tools to help you test and debug your applications.

testing_tools.description: Test your application directly in the development environment
Debug tool that shows detailed execution information
View and modify data during application execution

sections.title: Test Data Management
sections.content: Effective test data management is crucial for reliable and repeatable testing.

data_strategies.description: Create specific datasets for different testing scenarios
approaches: Use data pages for reusable test data

data_strategies.description: Ensure tests don't interfere with each other
techniques: Use unique identifiers for test cases
Clean up test data after execution

data_strategies.description: Verify that data is processed correctly

sections.title: Debugging Techniques
sections.content: When tests fail, effective debugging helps identify and resolve issues quickly.

debugging_approaches.description: Follow a structured approach to identify root causes
steps: Verify the fix resolves the issue

debugging_approaches.description: Use system logs to understand what happened
techniques: Review error messages and stack traces
Look for patterns in log entries

benefits: Easier to identify what caused issues
Reduced risk of introducing new problems

sections.title: Testing Best Practices
sections.content: Follow these practices to ensure effective and efficient testing.

practices: Define clear test objectives and success criteria
Create comprehensive test scenarios covering all use cases
Plan for both positive and negative testing
Allocate sufficient time for thorough testing
Test in environments similar to production
Use realistic data volumes and scenarios
Test with different user roles and permissions
Verify error handling and recovery procedures
Document all issues and their resolutions
Learn from testing results to improve future tests
Update test scenarios as the application evolves
Automate repetitive testing tasks where possible
Share testing knowledge with team members
Regularly review and optimize testing processes

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Different types of testing serve different quality assurance purposes
Well-designed test scenarios ensure comprehensive application coverage
PEGA provides powerful built-in tools for testing and debugging
Effective test data management is crucial for reliable testing
Systematic debugging approaches help resolve issues efficiently
Following best practices ensures thorough and efficient testing
